title: Three questions, then a call
summary: The gate that ends the page (#qualify): today's three-question logic, one question per screen, with the request you are writing shown beside it as it fills in, so 'your answers travel with the request' is visible, the decline is an honest no with exits, and the only red is the booking, once you qualify.

reference.site: Cofounder onboarding (big statement left, one question right, indexed answer rows) · Klaviyo starter guide (the step named in words, progress drawn small)
reference.borrowed: One question at a time with indexed answer rows that act on a single tap (no Continue button), and a progress marker that names the step in words. (Cofounder puts its statement left and the question right; here the question is left and the request it writes is right, mirroring the FAQ's ledger above.)
reference.kelwin: The right-hand panel (cols 9–12, under the header's facts column) is not a slogan: it is the mail the booking will open (To, Subject, the three answers, 'Preferred times'), filling in as you tap — today's exact mailto format, nothing sent from the page. Answers are the kit's ledger rows (index · label + detail · drawn arrow, a 1px --fg rule on hover), progress is the homepage ruler's grammar at three ticks, and Q03 carries a 'where the audit looks first' column that ties each answer to a layer page.

motion: entrance: the section's ruled seam draws (kit), the head fades and rises, the gate rises (360ms), the request beside it (480ms), and the under-note's hairline draws last.

interaction: hover (or keyboard focus) on an answer draws a 1px --fg rule across its top, nudges it 6px and draws its arrow in. A tap advances: the next screen fades in (260ms) while the screens ease to its height (320ms, so the under-note never jumps), the ruler's run extends to the next tick, the answer drops into the request on the right, focus moves to the new question's heading and the live region announces it. Back / Change last answer / Restart step back the same way. Browser Back and refresh keep progress (#qualify:b,a,b, with the same answers in history.state); Back moves focus to the restored screen's heading. A bare #qualify link (the nav's 'Audit request', the facts' 'Three questions', the FAQ's red) only brings you to the gate: the answers stay. A decline closes the request (only the answers given stay; its foot reads 'Closed here. Nothing was sent.') and hides the under-note, since the declined screen already offers 'Talk to the team anyway'. 'Book the strategic call' opens the mail app and swaps its note for the MailtoConfirm line with 'Copy the address'.

mockup demo (not on the live site): with no answers in the hash the gate plays its own flow once — B 'Post-revenue — real, but lumpy' → A 'Sales-led — a committee decides' → B 'Pipeline dies mid-funnel' — and rests qualified at ≈5.4s; the first click or key in the gate stops it. Review links: #qualify:a (declined at Q01), #qualify:b,c (declined at Q02, PLG), #qualify:b,a (Q03), #qualify:b,a,d (qualified, 'All three').
on the live site: no demo — the gate rests on question 1 (or on the hash's state). Step fades are off under reduced motion; focus and announcements stay.
story: The page's last section and its conversion moment: three taps qualify in both directions, the request writes itself beside the questions, and the call is booked from the visitor's own mail app; the not-ready exit sits under it.

At 1440 the request panel (≈567px) holds the row for Q01, Q02, declined and qualified; only Q03 is taller (≈655px), and the screens ease to it and back (320ms) so nothing below jumps. The decline reason for pre-revenue is kept verbatim [K]; note that it says 'no working motion to instrument yet', while the story map's voice rule says the audit 'reads', never 'instruments' (here the word is about the system Kelwin installs, but flag it).
